result.topic_en: Formula-only notes giving double-series expressions (cases n odd / n even) for equations labelled (63) and (64), involving sums of log tan(px/2) and log(4 cos^2(px/2)) over (2nt+p)^2 or (nt+p)^2, with x/2π = m/n; an upside-down integral fragment appears at the bottom.
result.transcription:
$\frac{x}{2\pi} = \frac{m}{n}$
(63) n impar. $= -\sum_{1,2n-1}^{p} \sum_{-\infty,\infty}^{t} \frac{\log \operatorname{tg} \frac{px}{2}^2}{(2nt+p)^{2}}$
n par $= -\sum_{-\infty,\infty}^{t} \sum_{1,n-1}^{p} \frac{\log \operatorname{tg} \frac{px}{2}^2}{(nt+p)^2}$
(64) n impar $= \sum_{1,2n-1}^{p} \sum_{-\infty,\infty}^{t} \frac{\log 4 \cos \frac{px}{2}^2}{(2nt+p)^2}$
n par $= + \sum_{1,n-1}^{p} \sum_{-\infty,\infty}^{t} \frac{\log 4 \cos (\frac{px}{2})^2}{(nt+p)^2}$
62) [-n impar-]

[upside down at bottom:] $\int^{\pi} e^{x i}, e^{nx i} \partial x \; \frac{\delta}{1-\delta e^{xi}}$ [?]
